Name: Purifier - Quality Essences and Extracts
Author: oneandonlyflexo
Description:
[b]Installation

[/b]Install all dependencies
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]﻿Latest SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720/]Json Assets Mods[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536/]Mail Framework Mod[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2642/]Custom Casks Mod[/url]
[/list]
Then simply put the Purifier folder in your Stardew Valley mods folder.

[b]Getting Started[/b]

You will need to unlock the Purifier recipe by getting 8 hearts with someone who deals in exotic items.  Once unlocked you will be able to craft a Purifier with some iron, refined quartz, solar essence, and void essence.  The purifier acts exactly like a cask but can be placed outside of the cellar and will increase the quality of oils, extracts, essences, and perfume.  Now if only there was someone who could improve on the design to make it more efficient...

 [spoiler]Sandy will gift you the recipe at 8 hearts and Maru will improve upon the design at 8 hearts once you've crafted a few of the base model[/spoiler]
